fato_historico: 1991: The current international treaty defending indigenous peoples, Indigenous and Tribal Peoples Convention, 1989, comes into force.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a breeze of connection, Gemini. Much like the global spirit of unity that protects the diverse cultures of our world, you may feel an urge to advocate for harmony. It is a good time to weave your words with kindness and consider how your unique voice can foster understanding among those around you. Let your curiosity lead the way.
frase_do_dia: Your words possess the power to bridge worlds and cultivate beautiful new connections.
significado_numero: A lucky vibration representing the discovery of hidden spiritual truths and wisdom.
conselho: Listen deeply to others today and let empathy be your guiding star in conversations.
